scripts.test: sh -c 'rm -rf .test-dist; tsc --ignoreConfig src/hex-math.ts src/viewport.ts src/render-lifecycle.ts src/api.ts src/affine-registration.ts src/tool-route.ts src/runtime-view.ts src/ui/dom.ts src/modules/worlds/world-form.ts src/modules/expeditions/expedition-input-policy.ts src/modules/expeditions/expedition-workflow.ts src/modules/expeditions/expedition-party-movement.ts src/modules/expeditions/expedition-watch-ledger.ts src/client-module-catalog.ts --outDir .test-dist --module ESNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --skipLibCheck; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test test/hex-math.test.mjs test/render-lifecycle.test.mjs test/tool-host.test.mjs test/tool-route.test.mjs test/contract-source.test.mjs test/runtime-view.test.mjs test/dom-input.test.mjs test/world-form.test.mjs test/api-error.test.mjs test/source-map-import.test.mjs test/expedition-workflow.test.mjs test/expedition-party-movement.test.mjs test/expedition-watch-ledger.test.mjs test/client-module-catalog.test.mjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status'
scripts.smoke:embedded: sh -c 'rm -rf .embedded-smoke-dist; tsc --ignoreConfig src/api.ts --outDir .embedded-smoke-dist --module ESNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --skipLibCheck; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test test/embedded-module-smoke.test.mjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .embedded-smoke-dist; exit $status'
scripts.build: npm run test && npm run typecheck && vite build
